from pathlib import Path
base=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689869/attempts/bb90a5c04b7e45689f74d9e2a14a4f73/system/state/workspace/programs')

p=base/'task-36998190.py'
source='''def transform(grid):
    # Split the grid around its solid separator row. The upper pattern masks
    # the lower pattern; surviving nonzero overlaps become color 2.
    split = next(i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if row and len(set(row)) == 1)
    top = grid[:split]
    bottom = grid[split + 1:]
    if len(top) != len(bottom):
        raise ValueError("upper and lower patterns must have matching heights")
    return [[2 if a != 0 and b != 0 else 0 for a, b in zip(upper, lower)]
            for upper, lower in zip(top, bottom)]
'''
p.write_text(source)
print(p, p.read_text())
